title: Commons Pool destroys an idle object when validation throws
summary: Both pool variants rethrew the original exception object. The parent stranded A and exhausted its single slot. The fix destroyed A once, created a distinct B and accepted its return with one idle and zero active.

change.description: Before, expect the exception with A still counted idle and no destruction callback. On the merge, expect the same exception instance, A destroyed once and counts (idle, active) = (0, 0) in both pools.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
